title: primalucelib refused SESTO SENSO 3 ARCO moves and syncs it had acknowledged
summary: The SESTO SENSO 3 (firmware 1.0.9) acknowledges MOT2 MOVE_ABS and SYNC_POS under MOT2.DEG; the library read only MOT2.STEP and MOT2.SYNC_POS, so the ARCO moved while ROTATOR_POSITION went ALERT at once, and syncs failed.
evidence: 20261023080442-7930-primaluce-arco-sestosenso3/verification.md (FND-000061); server log of the hardware session 2026-10-23

resolution.evidence: 20261023080442-7930-primaluce-arco-sestosenso3/verification.md: both acknowledgements are accepted under either key; sestosenso3_rotator_move/_sync pass and fail without the fix; hardware moves and syncs end OK. Retested on the tree merged with the audit repair (verification.md V10, V11).
